summary: The fund generally will invest at least 80% of its total assets in the securities that comprise the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to measure the performance of a portfolio of U.S. dollar-denominated high yield corporate bonds (commonly known as “junk bonds”) with maturities or, in some cases, “effective maturities” in the year 2033 (collectively, “2033 Bonds”). The fund is non-diversified.
